verdict.rationale: YPOG publishes detailed German-specific startup instrument content (VSOP tax treatment, ESOP/§19a GITA, Future Financing Act) and references UK-style Advance Subscription Agreements, but offices are exclusively in Germany and there is no evidence of published guidance on UK EMI schemes specifically, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, or French BSPCE. Missing for 10: dedicated UK EMI scheme content, Indian FDI/ESOP briefings, French BSPCE coverage, and jurisdictional presence beyond Germany.
